name: Dissolve-out defeat
oneLiner: A defeated unit blinks white and dissolves from a snapshot of its sprite (dither-noise fade, horizontal slice wipe, pixel crumble with gravity, or flash-then-fade) in about 0.5-1 s, so the game can remove the unit at once and nothing waits for the effect.
notFor: units that stay on the field when down (revivable knocked-out heroes keep their own fallen pose)
games where the corpse matters to play (looting, raising, blocking)
non-sprite renderers (3D meshes, DOM elements): the module needs a 2D canvas picture

needs: defeat event on the frame HP reaches 0: {target id, sprite rect on screen now, sprite image or a draw callback}
frame clock in ms (world time that pauses during hit-stop)
optional: rectangles to keep clear (banner, HUD, windows)
provides: promise / busy() per unit for code that chooses to wait
list of drawn effect rectangles (for other overlays to avoid)

assets: module/dissolve-defeat.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_DissolveDefeat): snapshot, four variants, clipping, drawing; colours and fade steps through GameDNA_Skin when loaded, built-in pixel16 values otherwise
